llm_response.reason: The website meets several established scam criteria: There is no verifiable business contact information, only a contact form; the privacy policy is ambiguous and unprofessional for an EU-facing business; there is no company registration or owner identity mentioned, suggesting a non-existent company; the SSL certificate is short-lived and possibly misconfigured; and links to 'Easy Clothes' as a possible attempt to mimic a legitimate brand. These factors outweigh the superficial professional appearance and match classic indicators of a fake online shopping scam.
